biothings.name: Bruton-type agammaglobulinemia
biothings.definition: X-linked agammaglobulinemia (XLA) is a clinically variable form of isolated agammaglobulinemia, an inherited immunodeficiency disorder, and is characterized in affected males by recurrent bacterial infections during infancy. [Orphanet:47]
biothings.synonyms: agammaglobulinemia, X-linked 1, X-linked recessive, Bruton type agammaglobulinemia, Bruton's Sex-linked agammaglobulinemia, Bruton's X-linked agammaglobulinemia, Bruton-type agammaglobulinemia, BTK-deficiency, X-linked agammaglobulinemia
